entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: The mightiest state on Muraganda, a kingdom of saurids and their human subjects ruled by the autarch.

entities.name: Muraganda

entities.name: Autarch
entities.description: Sole leader of the Autocracy, revered as a divine monarch.

entities.name: Mimeoplasm
